purpose: Use the Miles Deutscher AI-backtesting workflow as a frozen adversarial benchmark to measure how much apparent AI-generated strategy alpha survives honest evaluation, and to test whether LLM intelligence belongs in strategy compilation or decision-time trading.
research_questions: How much apparent in-sample alpha survives frozen holdout, realistic costs, multiplicity controls, null controls and regime splits?
Does a frozen deterministic LLM-authored factor outperform or non-inferiorly match a decision-time LLM action agent on unseen data after costs?
Does decision-time LLM reasoning add reproducible economic value sufficient to justify its extra variance, turnover, latency and API cost?

arms.B0_BUY_AND_HOLD: Deterministic buy-and-hold baseline on identical frozen sample.
arms.B1_SIMPLE_SMA: Deterministic simple SMA crossover baseline with frozen parameters.
arms.B2_SIMPLE_RSI: Deterministic simple RSI mean-reversion baseline with frozen parameters.
arms.A1_CONTENT_LOOP: LLM may iteratively propose and improve a strategy on training/design data only. Every attempted strategy remains counted. Final selected strategy is frozen before holdout reveal.
arms.A2_FACTOR_AUTHOR: LLM receives the permitted frozen design information once and emits deterministic executable strategy rules/code. No LLM is present at decision time.
arms.A3_ACTION_AGENT: LLM receives the same permitted information budget at each decision point and emits BUY/HOLD/SELL or equivalent bounded action. No self-modification or rule edits are allowed.

pre_registered_adjudication.MILES_CONTENT_EDGE_REJECT: If attractive training/backtest performance fails to beat the strongest simple deterministic baseline after frozen OOS costs and multiplicity/null controls.
pre_registered_adjudication.FACTOR_AUTHOR_SUPPORTED: A2 must show reproducible post-cost OOS value versus simple baselines and must not materially underperform A3 on the primary endpoint across required replication slices.
pre_registered_adjudication.FACTOR_AUTHOR_UNPROVEN: A2 does not clear deterministic/null baselines with reproducible post-cost OOS value.
pre_registered_adjudication.ACTION_AGENT_REJECT: A3 fails to materially improve the primary endpoint versus A2 while adding materially higher run variance, turnover, latency or API cost.
pre_registered_adjudication.ACTION_AGENT_RESEARCH_CONTINUES: A3 materially and reproducibly improves post-cost OOS utility versus A2 across BTC and ETH and more than one regime, with no unacceptable drawdown or instability penalty.

kill_criteria: Any detected holdout leakage invalidates the affected run.
Any use of quarantined non-PIT derived history invalidates the affected run.
Any tuning after holdout reveal invalidates confirmatory status and converts the run to exploratory only.
If deterministic baselines cannot be reproduced, the experiment stops before LLM comparison.
If identical-input reproducibility is below the contract threshold defined in the execution implementation, A3 cannot receive promotion regardless of PnL.
If results depend on one asset, one regime or one selected run, the claimed general architecture edge remains unproven.
revision_rule: Any material change after the first eligible model call requires a new experiment_id. Pre-call schema or path corrections may increment revision only if sample, hypotheses, endpoints, thresholds and evidence boundaries remain unchanged.
